title: CyberHull: Deterministic Malicious URL Isolation via Convex Hull
abstract: arXiv:2610.27675v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emergence of increasingly sophisticated and evasion-resistant phishing attack strategies represents a significant threat to modern cybersecurity, particularly in cyber-physical systems and internet-based networks. Traditional probabilistic methods and certain machine learning approaches often struggle to detect novel attacks and may lack interpretability or portability. To address these challenges, we introduce CyberHull, a resource-efficient and deterministic framework for identifying malicious URLs through mathematically defined convex hull boundaries across multiple orthogonal feature domains, including structural content entropy, hyperlink graph topology, and semantic token distribution. CyberHull constructs compact convex hulls, referred to as vaults, using the QuickHull algorithm, with a training complexity of O(n log n) under suitable assumptions. translated_title: CyberHull：基于凸包的确定性恶意URL隔离方法
translated_abstract: 日益复杂且具有抗规避能力的钓鱼攻击策略的出现，对现代网络安全构成了重大威胁，尤其是在信息物理系统和基于互联网的网络中。传统的概率方法和某些机器学习方法往往难以检测新型攻击，并且可能缺乏可解释性或可移植性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CyberHull，这是一种资源高效且具有确定性的框架，通过在多个正交特征域（包括结构内容熵、超链接图拓扑和语义标记分布）上构建数学定义的凸包边界来识别恶意URL。CyberHull使用QuickHull算法构建紧凑的凸包（称为“金库”/vaults），在适当假设下其训练复杂度为O(n log n)。URL分类通过多面体内部点测试来执行
tldr: 提出CyberHull框架，利用QuickHull算法在多个正交特征域上构建凸包边界，以资源高效、确定性的方式实现恶意URL的识别与隔离，训练复杂度仅为O(n log n)。
en_tdlr: CyberHull is a resource-efficient and deterministic framework that isolates malicious URLs by constructing compact convex hull boundaries (vaults) across multiple orthogonal feature domains using the QuickHull algorithm, achieving O(n log n) training complexity.
